annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/2185 sets lists of codes and device types used to specify the scope of notified bodies' designation under the EU Medical Devices Regulation 2017/745 and the IVD Regulation 2017/746. It includes codes for software-controlled devices, machinery-devices, active prostheses and rehabilitation devices, but has no robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Annex I lists MDA/MDN/MDS/MDT codes for medical device types for notified body designation.
Annex II lists IVR/IVS/IVT/IVP/IVD codes for in vitro diagnostic devices.
Conformity assessment bodies must use these codes when applying for designation.
Horizontal codes cover software-controlled devices and devices that are also machinery under Directive 2006/42/EC.
Enters into force the day after publication in the Official Journal; directly applicable.
